name: facebook
tagline: Publish and Monitor Facebook Pages from QuoxCORE
description: Governed organic Facebook Page publishing and monitoring: page reads, post feed, organic Page Insights, and Lead Ads retrieval. Vault-stored long-lived Page access token with tracked ~60-day expiry, human approval on every publish, content feed, compose-and-publish panel, and insights summary.
shortDescription: Facebook Page publishing, insights, and lead retrieval.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Publish Page posts with a governed, human-approved flow
List and monitor managed Pages with follower stats
Read organic Page Insights: impressions, engagement, fans
Retrieve Lead Ads forms and submitted leads
Content feed with per-post engagement counts
Compose panel with preview and character count

publishing.name: Page Publishing
publishing.description: Publish text posts, optional link, and optional image to a Facebook Page feed directly from QuoxCORE. Every publish files a human approval card first.

pages.name: Page Management
pages.description: List all Pages the token can manage, with categories and follower counts.

pageInsights.name: Page Insights
pageInsights.description: Read organic Page performance: impressions, post engagements, and fan counts across day, week, or 28-day windows.

leadAds.name: Lead Ads Retrieval
leadAds.description: List Lead Ads forms on a Page and retrieve submitted leads with field data.

contentFeed.name: Content Feed
contentFeed.description: Chronological view of recent Page posts with like, comment, and share counts.

specialist.name: FACEBOOK
specialist.description: Facebook Pages publishing and monitoring specialist
capabilities: Retrieve Lead Ads forms and leads
